head: dc12525d
sequenceNote: 1) Refresh core/content/util feature map for client+server, 2) tighten hydrology continuity for caves/rivers/lakes and world-map control parity, 3) validate protobuf bindings/fingerprints, 4) update docs + push.

server.name: world-map-control-parity
server.notes: Keep control profile hash/signature aligned with hydrology/cave tuning and protobuf fingerprint; refresh pipeline version and cache invalidation rules for streamed map tiles.

server.name: protocol-registry-validation
server.notes: Ensure generated EnhancedMinecraft DTOs and handler bindings validate at startup; tie world-map signatures to the descriptor fingerprint to catch stale assets.

client.name: world-map-preview-parity
client.notes: Unity previews mirror server hydrology/cave parameters; reloads when profile hash, world config, or proto fingerprint drift to avoid map-control desync.

client.name: protocol-client-bindings
client.notes: Client protobuf DTO references stay aligned with SharedProtocol registry and descriptor fingerprint; guards against stale generated assemblies.

server.name: cave-river-lake-continuity
server.notes: Hydrology-driven carving with edge continuity envelopes, seam-aware rivers/lakes, and ceiling sealing to keep subterranean water aligned with rivers and basins.

client.name: map-visualization
client.notes: Preview renderer consumes hydrology/flow/river/lake masks with seam-safe smoothing to display stitched terrain in editor/runtime.

server.name: data-driven-config-refresh
server.notes: JSON-backed config loader with checksum logging feeding world map control and hydrology/lake/cave thresholds; keep hashes in sync with map-control signatures.

client.name: streaming-profile-hotload
client.notes: Hot-reloads map-control JSON and resets preview generator when hash or signature changes; keeps data-driven parameters synced during runtime.
